weight.description: Weight of the objective in the total. Default 1.0. A real, or an array of reals that the continuation scheduler steps through.

weight_iterations.description: Iterations per step of the `weight` array. Read only when `weight` is an array or a constants name; defaults to `optimization.solver.continuation_iterations`.

mask_name.description: Point zone the objective is evaluated on; empty for the whole domain. Default empty.

name.description: Display name. Default depends on the type.

start_time.description: Start of the evaluation window; used only by unsteady runs. Default 0.0.

end_time.description: End of the evaluation window; used only by unsteady runs. Default: no end.

allOf.$comment: `weight_iterations` is read only when `weight` is an array or a constants name (which may name a vector) (sources/continuation/continuation_scheduler.f90:152-155).

dealias_sensitivity.description: Must equal `dealias_forcing` (an allOf rule enforces it); it has no effect of its own: it is read only to be compared with `dealias_forcing` (brinkman_dissipation_objective.f90:161-164). Default `case.numerics.dealias`.

dealias_forcing.description: Integrate the objective value, its adjoint forcing and its sensitivity on the over-integration (GL) points; this flag alone is passed on (brinkman_dissipation_objective.f90:166-167,253-257,304,386). Must equal `dealias_sensitivity`. Default `case.numerics.dealias`.

brinkman_dissipation_objective.f90:162 aborts when dealias_sensitivity differs from dealias_forcing. When only one is given, the case-file root compares it with case.numerics.dealias.
